All relevant tests pass. Here's a summary of the changes:

**`cmd/entire/cli/stringutil/stringutil.go`** — Added a fast path in `TruncateRunes` using `utf8.RuneCountInString(s)` before allocating `[]rune`. When no truncation is needed (the common case), this avoids the `[]rune` allocation entirely.

**`cmd/entire/cli/strategy/messages.go`** — Removed the upfront `[]rune` conversion in `TruncateDescription`. It now uses `utf8.RuneCountInString` for the length check and delegates entirely to `TruncateRunes` (with empty suffix for `maxLen < 3`).

The 3 failing tests (`TestRemoveGitHook_RemovesInstalledHooks`, `TestInstallGitHook_NoBackupWhenNoExistingHook`, `TestInstallGitHook_MixedHooks`) are pre-existing failures in hook installation tests, unrelated to these changes.
